data.headline: Software / Platform / AWS Devops Engineer ● BSc Computer Science ● PGCE Secondary Mathematics
data.about: Dynamic Software Engineer with over 2 years of experience in full stack development, adept in cloud security and infrastructure management. Key skills include AWS, Terraform, and Javascript, with demonstrated success in increasing CloudGuard security scores by 30%. Proven ability to enhance application performance and streamline processes through CI/CD practices.

subComponents.title: Software Engineer II - Core Platform Team
subComponents.caption: Mar 2025 - Present · 10 mos

description.text:
I am a member of the Core Platform Team.

My current and previous works include:
• Contribute to backend API code using Python and Boto
• Write tests in Pytest
• Remediate security issues involving AWS resources, which included:
   - migrated CloudFront distribution to use OAC instead of OAI to encrypt S3 origins with SSE-KMS (in Ansible)
   - migrated Redis cluster from an unencrypted cache cluster to an encrypted, at-rest and in-transit, replication group (in Ansible)
   - migrated Redshift from unencrypted to encrypted with KMS (in Ansible)
   - enabled WAFs in front of ALBs (in Terraform)
• Send reports generated from tools or various APIs to Slack with AWS resources i.e. EventBridge, SNS, Lambda, etc., using Terraform and Boto.
• Set up monitoring tool for Kubernetes cluster using OpenTelemetry Collector and AWS OpenSearch.

I was a member of the Checkout and Payments team. I worked on Missguided's re-platforming project to React.JS. Other previous works include:

•	Created React.JS checkout page according to Figma designs.
•	Contributed to updating and adding additional payment methods for checkout.
• Update or/and add APIs (REST and GraphQL) for checkout page services.
•	Fixed bugs in the current Preact checkout app.
•	Participated in researching technologies and creating spikes for the initial design phase of re-platforming to React, in particular,
       ** created a spike on how to implement Redux Tool Kit for better typed redux code
       ** researched how best to share components between teams using React Storybook and Bit.dev
•	Created a reusable React form so as to implement the DRY principle.
•	Fixed errors and updated versions in Missguided’s Local Development Environment, which uses Docker and Kubernetes on AWS.

Assist with rapid prototyping in order to support the technical recommendations in the Alpha phase of a project

•	Authentication and authorisation research and development of working prototypes of AWS Cognito on GovPaaS
•	Hosting and infrastructure research and development
•	Supported the technical lead with creating working prototypes and helped to de-risk the recommendations being taken through to the Alpha Assessment.
•	Active contributor to team agile and scrum working

NHS virtual visits enables the ability for patients to receive visits during C-19. This was a crucial project during the height of the pandemic that received critical acclaim. Worked on migrating the project from a per install software for each Trust in the NHS to a more sustainable SaaS platform.

•	 Fully responsible for implementing the managers account feature for a single trust.
•	 Refactored the Trust Manager ﬂow for managing hospitals and wards.
•	 Contributed to using Terraform to provision infrastructure to Azure.
•	 Facilitated agile team working including the creation of user journeys in the initial phase and created user stories in backlog.

The technologies used
•	Javascript / Node / Next.JS
•	Cypress / Jest (TDD)
•	PostgresQL to MS Azure SQL database
•	Terraform
•	DataDog
•	GitHub Actions / Docker (CI /CD)

Participated in Made Tech's academy training programme for twelve weeks. These were some of the technologies and principles we learnt:
•	Agile Methodologies
•	SOLID Principles
•	Clean Architecture
•	TDD
•	Git Version Control

In this training programme, we completed two projects which incorporated the principles and technologies that we have learnt in the programme:

1. Tic Tac Toe project
•	The project was coded in Ruby.
•	It was implemented through pair-programming.
•	The Minimax algorithm was implemented as the computer AI.

2. HR Project
•	This was a team project
•	The front-end was coded using React.
•	The back-end was coded using ASP.NET Core.
•	Docker and CircleCI were used for CI/CD.

Attended a coding bootcamp where I learnt about the technology and methodologies used in the software industry. I completed two projects:
 
 📰 Northcoders News(Reddit style news board)
•	Back-end RESTful API was built using Node.js, Express.js, PostgresQL.
•	Front-end was built with React.js and Bootstrap CSS Framework.
•	TDD was done with Mocha, Chai and Supertest
 
🌏 Tap That Map 
•	A world-map game built as a progressive web app to challenge a player’s geographical knowledge.
•	It is playable as a single-player or multiplayer.
•	This game was built in two weeks, where our MVP was a single-player game.
•	Agile programming practices such as pair-programming, daily stand-ups, Kanban board were used throughout the process.
•	Front-end was built with React.js, Google Maps API, Howler.js and Material UI.
•	Back-end was built with Firebase Realtime Database, Firebase Authentication and Firebase Cloud Storage.

•	Maintained appropriate school attainment records.
•	Undertook a designated programme of teaching across across all Key Stages.
•	Promoted the learning of Mathematics through out of school activities.
•	Maintained school-wide culture of respect and actively used positive behavioural interventions and supports disciplinary methods.
•	Attended all staff meeting and contribute positively to any discussions.
•	Attended parent-teacher meetings to discuss pupils' attainment and behaviour.
•	Kept classrooms safe, well-organised and tidy.

•	Made sure that the classroom was ready for lessons.
•	Listened to children read, read to them or tell them stories.
•	Supported children to complete their task.
•	Assisted teachers in planning activities and completing records.
